headline: Revenue beats guidance as profits and buybacks accelerate
summary_short: Globant reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $607.1 million, down 0.7% y/y but above the high end of its own guidance range, with net income of $37.0 million (+20.7% y/y) and diluted EPS of $0.85 (+25.0% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue was roughly flat y/y at $607.1 million, beating the company's own guidance range, while GAAP diluted EPS rose 25% y/y to $0.85; non-IFRS adjusted diluted EPS held flat at $1.50. IFRS gross margin slipped to 34.5% from 34.9% and non-IFRS adjusted operating margin fell to 14.1% from 14.8% on lower revenue against a similar cost base. Free cash flow was $36.1 million. The company spent $50.0 million on buybacks in Q1 and announced a new $125 million repurchase authorization after completing the prior program. Q2 FY2026 guidance: revenue $610-616 million, adjusted diluted EPS $1.45-1.55; full-year guidance: revenue $2,462-2,508 million, adjusted diluted EPS $6.10-6.50.
